author: Cleo Abram
description:
These brain cells on a dish look like they’re playing the video game DOOM. But are they actually? I emailed the scientists to find out…

Experts think this could lead to efficient bio computers or ways to study neurological diseases!

If you think you could beat the brain cells, subscribe!

title: Are These Brain Cells Really Playing DOOM?
